FAIRGROUNDS TEST: shown, weakly. The fair's rentals page prices RV hook-ups by the day ($33.60) apart from the event-night rate ($22.40 'W/ Event'), which implies non-event rentals; it does not say in words that travelers can stay any night. Search-engine snippets of RV Life reviews (not read directly - the review text did not load) describe 'basically a parking lot that had hook ups', paid $33 / $67 / $17 nightly in 2024, and that during events 'you probably can't get any of the sites'. On imagery a row of RVs lines the west edge of the main paved lot. Reviewer may want a call to 307-235-5775 to confirm walk-up nights.
